evidence.quote: SMEJ Guardrail is now being used across more than 300 AWS accounts and helps protect 1,300 websites launched by its teams.
SMEJ Guardrail also uses Amazon GuardDuty to monitor accounts for suspicious activities and AWS CloudTrail to track account actions across AWS and support audits and governance.
The foundation of SMEJ Guardrail is AWS Security Hub, a unified security service that centralizes and prioritizes security findings across various AWS services.
